name: Fillman & Sons Floors & More
description: Flooring contractor in Emmaus, Lehigh County. Hardwood, the jobs around it, and a family name on the van. Confirm hours on the official site.

hero.headline: Floors, and the work around them
hero.sub: Fillman & Sons Floors & More is a Lehigh County flooring shop. The current site is not built for a phone. The floor still has to be measured, delivered, and finished.

offerings.heading: Measure, install, finish.
items: Hardwood and the flooring jobs a family shop will still take.
Installation that respects the subfloor you already have.
The “and more” on the door: the adjacent work they will name when you ask.

story.heading: A family name on the van
paragraphs: Fillman & Sons Floors & More is listed in Emmaus. The radar scored the site as broken: no viewport on a phone.
Confirm the street address, phone, and what “and more” covers on the official site before you order material. We will not invent a showroom suite.

experience.heading: How a floor job should go.
items: They measure the rooms you have, including the closets you forgot.
You see the finish on a sample, not only on a screen.
They come back to the edges when the house settles.

feature.heading: The site should be as straight as the plank
feature.text: A flooring company that hides the phone on mobile is fighting its own close. The rebuild puts the map, the next action, and the work on the first screen.

items.title: And more
items.text: Ask what the shop will take.

items.title: Contact
items.text: Confirm the shop on the official site.

contact.heading: Confirm before you drive.
contact.sub: Emmaus, Lehigh County. Pull live address and phone from the official site.
